summary: After the restore, start the services again with `systemctl --user start` on each node: `pcp`, the controller task, web, rsyslog and `receptor`, hub API, content, web and workers, all EDA services, `automation-gateway` and `automation-gateway-proxy`, and `redis-unix redis-tcp`.
